description: This file contains extension methods for integrating Orleans silos with various host builder patterns in .NET. It provides methods to configure and add Orleans silos to host applications, handling different hosting models like IHostBuilder, IHostApplicationBuilder, HostApplicationBuilder, and IServiceCollection. The core functionality involves setting up Orleans silo builders within host configuration pipelines, with methods ensuring that multiple calls are idempotent or produce appropriate exceptions.

classes.name: OrleansSiloGenericHostExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for hosting Orleans silos in various host builder patterns.

methods.description: Extension method to configure an IHostApplicationBuilder or HostApplicationBuilder to host an Orleans silo, with optional configuration delegate.

methods.description: Extension method to add Orleans silo configuration to an IServiceCollection.
